_doc: Hop dong env: ten bien MOI bo trien khai (kit) phai tu dat (gen-env.sh / env.template / filebox-env.sh / docker-compose.yml), vi mac dinh trong code am tham tat tinh nang. Chi ten, khong gia tri. Kiem: bun run check:env-contract

vars.name: HUB_PROCESS_ROUTES
vars.note: vang => module quy trinh off => Yeu cau/Viec cua toi/duyet 404

vars.name: HUB_PROCESS_ENGINE
vars.note: vang => Cai dat > Quy trinh duyet 404

vars.name: HUB_NOTIFY_MODE
vars.note: mac dinh off => khong gui mail; ca hai kit dat tuong minh off (khong SMTP). Bat live = nguoi dung cap SMTP roi doi tay

vars.name: HUB_PARTNER_MAILBOX
vars.note: vang (mac dinh off) => gui doi tac xac nhan bi chan PARTNER_CHANNEL_OFF

vars.name: HUB_FAST_ROUTE
vars.note: vang (mac dinh off) => tin khong tag di vong Orchestrator

vars.name: HUB_STICKY_AGENT
vars.note: vang (mac dinh off) => tin khong tag khong dinh agent vua tra loi. stg-test chua dat (lech da ghi o tasks chore-env-cleanup)

vars.name: DIFY_CONSOLE_URL
vars.note: vang => khong co nut Mo trong Dify o Admin > Workflows

optional.name: HUB_SMTP_HOST
optional.note: chi khi HUB_NOTIFY_MODE=live: khoi tao kho secret mail MOT lan (CR-121 D4). Ten co trong env.template; mail tat => khong dat

optional.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
optional.note: bi mat, chi khi live: dat tay tren server, khong ghi vao repo

optional.name: CONTRACTS_EXTRACT_TIMEOUT_S
optional.note: CR-155: tran mot luot AI doc HD (10-3600 giay)

optional.name: CONTRACTS_EXTRACT_READ_TIMEOUT_S
optional.note: CR-155: han doc HD (giay); tu nang >= tran AI + 30

_allowDiffWhy: Chenh co ly do: ha tang chi prod (pgbouncer, pool, ops-status, Dify, tran runtime), co tuy chon chi prod (sticky, SMTP/DocuSign/Trello khi co that), co dev/test chi stg-test (S2_STACK, LOGIN_IP_MAX_ATTEMPTS, HUB_SEED_FIXTURES, seed tool).
